summary: ICICI Bank filed a Form 6-K disclosing completion of a USD 1 billion senior unsecured fixed-rate note issuance under its USD 7.5 billion Global Medium Term Note Programme. The notes carry ratings of BBB (S&P) and Baa3 (Moody's) and will list on IFSC exchanges and SGX-ST. This is a routine debt capital markets transaction, not a special situation. No change of control, strategic event, or extraordinary corporate action is involved. The filing is a standard foreign issuer report; no further special-situation analysis is warranted.
